# Curiosities Magazine

> Curiosities Magazine is a responsive demo site built with semantic HTML and CSS, with a photo section, products, services and a newsletter form.

## Pages

- [Curiosities Magazine](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/): Curiosities Magazine is a responsive demo site built with semantic HTML and CSS, with a photo section, products, services and a newsletter form.
- [Our Products](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/ourProducts.html): Browse the demo product catalogue of Curiosities Magazine, with men and women product cards, prices and category filters built in pure CSS.
- [First Product Details](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/productFirst.html): Detail page for the first demo product in Curiosities Magazine, with a package list, a schedule table and an add to cart link.
- [Second Product Details](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/productSecond.html): Detail page for the second demo product in Curiosities Magazine, with a package list, a schedule table and an add to cart link.
- [Third Product Details](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/productThird.html): Detail page for the third demo product in Curiosities Magazine, with a package list, a schedule table and an add to cart link.
- [Photo Gallery](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/gallery.html): Photo gallery of the Curiosities Magazine demo site, a responsive image grid built with semantic HTML and CSS and no JavaScript.
- [Services](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/services.html): The services page of Curiosities Magazine lists demo offer cards with short descriptions and links through to the product catalogue.
- [About Us](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/aboutUs.html): Read about the Curiosities Magazine demo project, a responsive multi-page site written as a university HTML and CSS assignment.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about orders, delivery addresses, warranty, free shipping and tracking on the Curiosities Magazine demo shop.
- [Contact Us](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/contact.html): The contact page of Curiosities Magazine has a validated form for name, email, date, phone and message, built with HTML and CSS only.
- [Privacy Policy](https://projekt1.dawidolko.pl/privacy.html): Privacy policy page of the Curiosities Magazine demo site, a static sample document that shows the layout of a legal page.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dawidolko/CuriositiesMagazine-Project-HTML-CSS): Source code and setup notes for the project.
